adventures.name: North Table Mountain MTB day
adventures.matchSource: Strava GPS export
adventures.note: Frankie joined me for the final leg at North Table Mountain on my new mountain bike. The initial climb was incredibly steep and I was not prepared for it, so I walked most of the way up. Once we were up, we had a great time on an epic trail, and light snow started falling toward the end. It was a great finish to the Colorado Triathlon.
